reviews.text:
We went for an introductory session in the pool, and the result was excellent.
Our Staffy was incredibly afraid of water.
Today he dives into the pool and the sea tirelessly, we have to beg him to come out😅.
Salvatore, with his professionalism and kindness, gave us a great experience.
Highly recommended.

I couldn't have asked for a better person for my first dog experience! Salvatore is extremely knowledgeable, attentive, and always available to give me helpful advice on training my Amstaff. Leaving her with him during the day gives me complete peace of mind, and seeing the joy with which she returns every morning is proof of that. An impeccable resource!
friendly, kind and empathetic, a center in the center of the city!

We contacted Mr. Doggy to help us manage the behavioral issues of our four-year-old mixed breed dog who pulled a lot on the leash during walks. Thanks to Salvatore's professionalism and experience, we were able to effectively resolve this issue. A truly positive experience!
